duration: 10 weeks, one 4-hour shift per week (34 hours or more)
name: Summer Student Volunteer Program at St. Luke's Hospital
what_you_do: Student volunteers guide patients and visitors. They also help with wheelchairs on the hospital campus. They do not watch procedures or give patient care.
who_can_apply: High school and college students who are at least 16 when they submit the application. A student who turns 16 during the summer must wait for the next summer.
deadline_text: In 2026 the application link opened March 27 and stayed up for 48 hours. Dates for summer 2027 are not posted on the program page.
how_to_apply: Watch the program page early next year. The link was open for only 48 hours in 2026. You must attend the mandatory orientation and finish the screening.
notes: In 2026 the program ran June 8 to August 14, Monday through Friday. Screening has a urine drug screen, a background check (Social Security number needed), and blood tests for TB, measles, mumps and rubella. You also need proof of a flu shot or agree to get one. Call 314-542-4768 with questions.
